renderer_limitation: The installed grouped_bar renderer cannot combine mixed units with a negative value; this custom SVG preserves the paper Completion change of -2.80 percentage points.
title: Similar aggregate gain, different selected changes
description: A compact measured comparison shows Macro relative gain of 10.93% for the local reconstruction and 10.78% in the paper report, alongside selected axis changes for Completion and Slot. Completion changed by +7.04 versus -2.80 percentage points, and Slot changed by +7.01 versus +27.80 percentage points. Call and Relevance are intentionally omitted from this featured view.

layout_geometry.design_note: Panel width follows information density rather than geometric symmetry. Muted a./b. headings and a smaller left plot keep the denser selected-axis panel visually primary without changing the data scales. Optical margins move the title and left panel inward and the mechanism downward so visible content has comparable left/right and top/bottom breathing room inside the framed hero.
